page_title: Voqusa — Transcribe Video & Audio to Text

sources.entry: Voqusa - Turns TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and other social videos into accurate transcripts and subtitles in seconds, no signup required. #freemium #transcription

summary.name: Voqusa
summary.one_liner: Voqusa is a browser-based AI tool that turns videos from TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, and Pinterest, or uploaded audio and video files, into editable text transcripts.
use_cases: Repurpose social videos into blog posts or captions
Study competitor video hooks and structures
Generate captions and subtitles for accessibility
Translate a video transcript into another language
summary.what_it_does: Users paste a public video link from a supported platform or upload an audio or video file, and the AI extracts speech, adds punctuation, and returns an editable transcript. The transcript can be copied, downloaded as TXT, SRT, or VTT, or translated into 14+ output languages inside the tool. It supports 80+ source languages with automatic language detection. The site also lists free in-browser subtitle converters for SRT, VTT, and TXT files. Credits cover paid usage, and the core tool runs in the browser without installation.
notable: Supports 7 social platforms with one paste-a-link workflow
Translation of transcripts into 14+ output languages included free
Free in-browser SRT, VTT, and TXT subtitle converters
caveats: Speech-to-text costs 1 credit per minute after 5 free signup credits; packs start at $1.99 and credits expire after 12 months
Only public video URLs are supported for links
Accuracy drops with background noise, heavy accents, overlapping speakers, or music louder than voice
